data.name: Gofoot
data.detailed_description:
GoFoot is a fast, lightweight, and highly customizable football management game, made for players who miss the era of simple, addictive, and straightforward football managers.

⚽Build Your Career⚽

  • Create your manager and choose the club you want to lead.

  • Select the leagues and competitions that will be part of your game.

  • Play through multiple seasons, face promotion and relegation battles, and build your own football story.

⚽Build Your Team⚽

  • Manage your squad and arrange your players on a visual tactics board.

  • Choose your formation and adjust mentality, marking, transitions, creative freedom, and attacking style.

  • Manage starters, substitutes, suspensions, injuries, and player fitness.

⚽Experience Every Matchday⚽

  • Follow matches featuring goals, cards, substitutions, and real-time events.

  • Analyze statistics, assists, individual ratings, and team performances.

  • Check results, fixtures, standings, top scorers, and the best-performing players.

⚽Trade and Develop Players⚽

  • Sign players through offers and counteroffers.

  • Put players up for sale and receive bids from other clubs.

  • Find new signings using filters for position, age, nationality, ability, and value.

  • Develop youth prospects and promote new talent to the senior squad.

⚽Dynamic Player Careers⚽

  • Each player's form changes according to their performances and time spent out of the team.

  • Age, talent, and performance influence attribute development.

  • Market value evolves alongside each player's form and development.

  • Career histories, charts, and statistics record their journey across the seasons.

⚽Manage the Club⚽

  • Control wages, transfers, prize money, sponsorships, and other financial activity.

  • Set ticket prices and monitor attendance and matchday revenue.

  • Expand different areas of your stadium and manage ongoing construction.

⚽Create Your Own Football Universe⚽

Use the editor to customize clubs, players, youth prospects, managers, and round-robin competitions. Change information, attributes, squads, and badges to play with the database you want.

Easy to learn. Lightweight to run. Hard to put down.
